name: gizza-ai/csv-transpose
summary: Transpose a CSV (swap rows and columns).

tool.description: Transpose a CSV: swap its rows and columns so the header row becomes the first column and vice versa. The output has one row per input column and one column per input row; ragged rows are padded with empty cells. delimiter is a single char or comma/tab/semicolon/pipe. Runs locally.

delimiter.description: Field separator: a single char or 'comma'/'tab'/'semicolon'/'pipe'. Default ','.
